Man City verdict will leave a stain and stench on a Premier League era. Rio Ferdinand leads reaction to Man City's 115 breaches case: 'Another Premier League medal'. England travel to Prague to take on Czechia as the 2026-27 Nations League campaign continues, and you can follow all of the updates with ESPN. The Three Lions are looking to get their first points on the board in the competition after falling to a 3-2 defeat at the hands of Spain last time out. Thomas Tuchel's side began Group A3 with a 3-2 defeat by the world champions at Wembley on Saturday. Czechia also come into the game looking to get on the board for this campaign after a 2-1 home defeat by Croatia.

data.title: England vs. Czechia prediction, lineups, odds and bet builder tips for UEFA Nations League clash - sportingnews.com
data.content: England's Saturday night against Croatia in Rijeka was less a football match than a masterclass, and Thomas Tuchel's side now return to Wembley on Tuesday with Czechia next in line and Harry Kane one second away from history. The captain struck twice in Croatia for his 88th and 89th international goals, and he will equal Peter Shilton's record of 125 England caps should he play in this game. England have racked up nine goals without reply across their last two games, climbing to second in League A Group 3, three points behind Spain. England scored seven against Croatia and two against this same opponent in Prague last week, so including the home loss to Spain, they have managed two goals in each of their last three matches and nine without reply in their past two. England also beat the Czechs 5-0 at Wembley in 2019 and have never lost at home to them.
